statement: Divinity unlocks at the start of World 5 and is a passive skill that levels like Laboratory.
Four things to watch: Divinity point gain, Divinity EXP gain, unlocking new gods, and which gods to use on which characters.
Put a character on an altar to open the Divinity menu and pick training options.
Kinesis style gives 1 Divinity point and 1 EXP per hour at start; Chakra, unlocked after a few levels, gives a bit more.
Style tab values shown are base values; multipliers increase them but the page does not reflect it.
Sit on Focus for a while until about the first 4 gods are unlocked; after that focus on leveling characters.
Mantra gives 1 EXP per hour to all characters.
Some EXP multipliers do not carry over to all characters so Mantra is not as direct an increase as it seems.
Have 6-8 characters on Mantra to level at a decent rate and unlock Vitalic as soon as possible.
Vitalic gives no Divinity but saves time by giving multiple characters much more EXP per hour.
Best at that point is 2 base EXP per hour; with 6 characters on Mantra you gain 6 EXP per hour.
Vitalic on multiple characters is a big EXP boost since multipliers apply fully; gives more than 8 characters on Mantra.
Vitalic lets you start generating Divinity points again.
TranQi gives 3 EXP per hour even when not on the Divinity altar.
Must get TranQi on all characters; use it whenever not actively training Divinity so you eventually unlock Zen.
Characters actively training Divinity should be on Zen asap: 8 Divinity and 8 EXP per hour.
The level 80 style gives about 10 Divinity and 10 EXP per hour but is not mandatory to reach asap.
Unlock new gods by spending Divinity points on 1 of 2 offering options.
Options are 1/5/10% on left or 25/50/100% on right; cost scales with percentage, 1% is 139k, 100% is 13.9M; options random.
Each button press spends the points and rerolls two new options.
He saves for the 13M 100% option rather than gambling 139k on 1%.
Info tab shows Divinity per hour per character with multipliers and does the math.
Four gods give multipliers upgradable with resources and two Sailing artifacts boost Divinity gain significantly.
Check EXP per hour with all multipliers in AFK Info.
Using Zen with 8 base EXP he gains 196 EXP per hour.
Each god has a Linked Bonus (main reason), a Minor Linked Bonus, and a Blessing.
Snehebatu linked bonus gives 30% AFK gain rate.
Use Snehebatu on most characters until you unlock better gods.
Most important use of Snehebatu is collecting 3D Printer samples since it significantly increases sample size.
AFK gain applies to skills; more kills per hour when fighting; more ladles from cooking.
Snehebatu minor bonus is accuracy and defense; least of your concerns in World 5 but fine if nothing better.
Snehebatu blessing gives about 2% Divinity gain per level costing Gaming pixels; can be maxed decently into Gaming for 200% total.
Arctis keeps the linked character always connected to the lab so you can pull them out to progress while keeping lab bonuses.
Arctis minor link gives more talent levels to all talents with at least 1 point.
Arctis minor bonus works like Symbols of Beyond from elite classes giving more talent points.
Arctis on more than 6 characters is a late game talent choice and there may be better options.
Arctis blessing gives more Divinity gain and is leveled using gold bars from Sailing.
Gold bars are fairly easy to get enough for a high Arctis blessing level.
Have at least 6 characters on Arctis at all times unless putting one back in the lab for printer sampling.
Nobisect linked bonus gives 2x kills per hour while opening portals or leveling Death Note.
Nobisect is only useful during the initial world push through maps or for extra Death Note multikill bonuses.
Nobisect minor bonus is total damage based on your Divinity levels so actual amount varies.
Total damage from Nobisect is a small gain given other sources (110% shown); not the main reason to use it.
Nobisect blessing gives scaled skill efficiency; additive to base skill efficiency and scales with it.
Worth leveling Nobisect blessing as another way to boost skill efficiency; uses Gaming pixels and scales high so long-term.
Harriep is one of the best gods; get it as soon as possible though with caveats.
Harriep gives 3x more 3D Printer resources for the linked character.
Harriep multiplies with the lab bonus doubling so a linked character in the lab with a good sample gives 6x printer resources.
Harriep minor link is one of the best coin gains; no other bonus gives as much.
Harriep blessing gives more Divinity and is upgraded with coins which is easy especially with its coin minor bonus.
Goharut makes being in the Lab also count as connected to the Divinity altar so both level simultaneously.
Goharut not recommended except if characters still need lab levels for more chip slots.
For a very high sample on one character, link one god to Snehebatu and the other 9 characters' Goharut minor bonus.
This combo can give another 25% AFK gain on the one sampling character.
Links can only be changed once per week so time swaps right before weekly reset then change back after.
Goharut blessing gives sailing speed; spending Gaming pixels on it is one of the best things for high-end Sailing.
Won't use Omniphau on any character due to too much RNG.
On login Omniphau gives a chance that collected AFK time also progresses other things like Refinery and 3D Printer.
Only one option progresses and only Refinery and Printer are useful; others (Sailing Gaming Cooking Breeding) not helpful.
Omniphau is only useful for its Divinity gain blessing.
Omniphau minor link gives additive class EXP; pointless since many other class leveling options.
Omniphau blessing levels with atom particles for more Divinity gain; requires good sampling.
Purrmep is where unlocking gods gets difficult and needs a lot of Divinity points.
Get Purrmep asap; bonuses are irreplaceable.
Purrmep major link: all characters produce 2x Divinity and 2x Divinity EXP.
Always have 1 character linked to Purrmep except briefly for something specific.
Purrmep minor gives sailing speed; keep it linked until basically done with World 5.
Purrmep plant growth speed bonus is okay but just an extra.
Purrmep blessing gives sailing speed upgraded with coins and gets expensive at later levels.
Flutterbis is the last god with active bonuses currently; this is the point to get to in Divinity.
Two more gods can be unlocked; benefit discussed with Elemental Sorcerer near end.
Flutterbis link: leveling a skill over 50 can drop a Divinity Pearl giving EXP to skills under 50.
Flutterbis link useful for leveling a new character's skills or an under-leveled Maestro.
Flutterbis minor gives skill EXP; useful for Maestro whose skill leveling is weak.
Also useful to level skills to unlock higher tools like a new pickaxe.
Flutterbis blessing gives 1% total damage per level; needs lots of atom particles and good sampling.
World 1 Divine Stamp gives more Divinity EXP gain and is doubled by the Laboratory.
Spiral Statue at bottom of statue list gives more Divinity EXP.
Get the Spiral Statue in Golden Statues to make it active on all characters.
Pious at Heart bubble gives Divinity EXP gain at decent rate and is cheap; grab asap.
Gifts Abound gives a chance to not spend Divinity points when offering.
Gifts Abound only useful early game so don't invest heavily.
Maple Syrup Vial gives 2% Divinity EXP per level at base and is doubled by lab.
Easy to level with decent samples.
Post Office Divinity Box is unlocked by a Sailing artifact; gives Divinity EXP Divinity gain and a little Wisdom.
It takes 800 boxes to get 50% more Divinity EXP.
Prefers putting boxes into Sailing or Gaming over Divinity unless boxes are left over.
No Divinity bonuses available in World 3.
Dinner menu Cotton Candy gives 2% Divinity EXP per plate level.
Wrath Grapes give 4% Divinity EXP per plate level.
Both Cotton Candy and Wrath Grapes are worth picking up.
Ashen Urn (Rocky Peaks) gives Divinity gain per class level of highest character; up to 400 with Ancient Form so about 4x.
Jade Rock (Toxic Bay) gives 3% Divinity per 10 slab items after 500; he gets 180%.
Ancient Form doubles Jade Rock so about 4-5x Divinity.
Billcye Tri artifact unlocks the Divinity Post Office Box and gives more Divinity gains if you invest in the box.
Elemental Sorcerer talent Shared Beliefs gives more Divinity EXP gain to all characters.
Highly recommends points in Shared Beliefs even on a combat spec for quicker Divinity leveling.
Polytheism talent unlocks a second god link for that character; leveling it cycles through different gods.
At level 13 Polytheism gives him Harriep as second link.
Delevel Polytheism without respec by standing under the elephant; it ticks down so you can reinvest points slowly.
Polytheism also gives Divinity points bonus for that character; max points if actively training Divinity on the sorcerer.
God's Chosen Children gives more damage to all characters but needs all 10 gods unlocked.
He is leveling it but gains no bonus since he doesn't have all 10 gods yet.
